name: Variant stack reveal
looks: Three or four near-identical panels fan out behind a main panel, each offset slightly in position and rotation, then settle into place. The shot shows at a glance that many were made, where cutting between single variants one at a time would not.
build: Position each panel's offset (x, y, rotation, small scale) from a seeded random function, staggering their entrances unevenly by 10-30 percent on spring eases, and give each variant a small, clearly visible difference such as a colour, a headline or a layout.
sound: A soft cluster of hits, one per panel.
prompt: Fan three or four near-identical panels out behind a main one, each nudged slightly in position and rotation before settling, to show at a glance that many variants, designs or options exist rather than cutting between them one at a time. Give each panel one small, visible difference so the variety actually reads.
